title: •Ur’Ru’r
caption: •Ur’Ru’r (V)
game_text: Deploys only on Tatooine. During your deploy phase, if with URoRRuR’R’R, may ▼ a weapon with “Tusken” in lore here; your weapon destiny draws for such weapons are +2. During your deploy phase, may move Ur’Ru’r as a regular move.
lore: Fierce Tusken Raider. Ransacks homes and moisture farms on the borders of Mos Espa.

notes: Unique. Curly apostrophes in heading/strip (Ur’Ru’r). Stats POWER 2 / ABILITY 1 (same as printed); deploy 2 / forfeit 4 (printed 2 / 2). Icon column: warrior (blue box, blaster). Alien. ▼ where the stub expands the deploy phrase; curly double quotes around “Tusken”. Lore matches the scan (no apostrophes, no bold words). Base card Special Edition (1998), SE-style line; not legible at 350. Base scan only at 350 px. Modern: Virtual Block 1 only (VB1 -pre, 350).
